home.faq.label: FAQ
home.faq.lede: Clear answers to help you use with confidence.
home.faq.a1: The Tel-Aqua pH meter measures pH (0-14) in a single dip - no app or lab visit required.
home.faq.q2: How accurate is the Tel-Aqua pH Meter?
home.faq.a2: The Tel-Aqua pH Meter has a resolution of 0.01 pH and an accuracy of ±0.2 pH when calibrated correctly. For reliable readings, re-calibrate the meter periodically using the appropriate calibration buffers.
home.faq.q3: How do I calibrate the meter?
home.faq.a3: Use the buffer sachets in the box on day one. It takes a few minutes and keeps every reading trustworthy.
home.faq.q4: Is it suitable to both shrimp and fish ?
home.faq.a4: Yes. It is built for shrimp and fish pond water - suitable for both freshwater and brackish aquaculture conditions.
home.faq.q5: How do I maintain the probe?
home.faq.a5: Rinse the probe with clean water after each use, keep the protection cap on when stored, and avoid letting the electrode dry out.
home.faq.q6: What is included in the box?
home.faq.a6: Tel-Aqua pH meter, calibration buffer sachets, protection cap, and full documentation with every unit.

about.intro.lede: For two years, we taught farmers about their water — and never sold them anything.
about.intro.p2: Along the way, one question kept coming back, in every pond and every district: how do I actually measure my water? Farmers weren't short on effort or knowledge. They were short on a simple, trustworthy way to see what was happening beneath the surface.
about.intro.p3: So we built the tool we wished every farmer already had — simple to use, accurate enough to trust, and priced so it was never a hard decision.
about.mission.body: Put a simple, accurate way to measure pond water into the hands of every shrimp and fish farmer — so no one has to guess with their crop again.
about.vision.body: A future where understanding your water is as ordinary as feeding your pond — no lab trip, no jargon, no barrier between a farmer and the truth about their crop.

returns.replacement.heading: Replacement
returns.replacement.intro: Tel-Aqua stands behind every meter with replacement coverage for manufacturing defects and covered faults. This policy explains replacement terms and warranty coverage only.
returns.replacement.p1: If something is wrong with your meter under the coverage below, we will replace it. Message us on WhatsApp or email care@telaqua.in and we will guide you through the claim.
returns.warranty.heading: Warranty
returns.warranty.intro: We build instruments for farmers, and we stand behind them.
returns.warranty.d7.body: If anything is wrong with your meter within 7 days of delivery, tell us and we will replace it.
returns.warranty.d7.note: You do not need to explain.
returns.warranty.m12.body: If it will not switch on, the display fails, the buttons stop responding, or it will not hold calibration, we replace it free for 12 months from the day you register it.
returns.warranty.m6.body: The electrode is the sensitive glass tip that measures your water.
returns.warranty.m6.note: It is covered for 6 months against manufacturing defects.
returns.care.heading: Please read this — the most important thing about your meter
returns.care.lead: The electrode must never be allowed to dry out.
returns.care.step1: Rinse the tip in clean water.
returns.care.step3: Put the cap back on with a little storage solution or buffer inside.
returns.care.neverWater: Never store it in plain water — plain water damages the electrode.
returns.care.good: Stored correctly, your electrode will work for a year or more.
returns.care.bad: Stored dry, it can be ruined in a few weeks.
returns.care.tech: This is true of every pH meter in the world, from the cheapest to the most expensive laboratory instrument.
returns.care.notFault: It is how the technology works, not a fault in the product.
returns.care.notCovered: An electrode damaged by dry storage is not covered by warranty — but you do not need a new meter.
returns.care.replace: Replacement electrodes are available from us at a fair price.
returns.notCovered.heading: Not Covered
returns.notCovered.item2: Water entering beyond the rated depth
returns.notCovered.item4: Opening or tampering with the meter
returns.notCovered.item5: Electrode damage from dry storage or storage in plain water
returns.notCovered.item6: Normal electrode ageing after the covered period
returns.claim.heading: How to Claim
returns.claim.intro: Message us on WhatsApp or email care@telaqua.in with:
returns.claim.item2: A photo or short video showing the problem
returns.claim.item3: A note on how you have been storing the meter
returns.claim.response: We respond within 24 hours and, where the claim is covered, ship a replacement.
returns.activate.heading: Activate Your Warranty
returns.activate.p1: Register your meter and confirm your first calibration to start your warranty.
returns.activate.p2: It takes one minute, and we will show you exactly how to calibrate and store your meter so it lasts for years.
privacy.hero.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.hero.subtitle: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how Tel-Aqua collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you visit our website or purchase our products.
privacy.intro.heading: 1. Introduction
privacy.intro.p1: Tel-Aqua (“we”, “us”, or “our”) sells digital pH meters and related accessories designed for shrimp and fish farmers. We are committed to protecting the privacy of every customer and visitor who uses our website at https://telaqua.in.
privacy.intro.p2: This Privacy Policy describes the personal information we collect, why we collect it, how we use and share it, and the choices available to you. By using our website or placing an order, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
privacy.collect.heading: 2. Information We Collect
privacy.collect.intro: Depending on how you interact with Tel-Aqua, we may collect or process the following information:
privacy.collect.item6: Order details (products ordered, quantity, amount, and order status)
privacy.collect.item7: Payment information (processed securely through Razorpay; Tel-Aqua does not store complete card or UPI credentials)
privacy.collect.outro: We collect this information when you browse our site, create or update an order, contact support, register a product for warranty, or otherwise communicate with us.
privacy.use.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
privacy.use.intro: We use personal information only for legitimate business purposes, including:
privacy.use.item2: Shipping products to the address you provide
privacy.use.item5: Sending order confirmations, shipping updates, and other transactional notifications
privacy.use.item7: Improving our website, products, and customer experience
privacy.use.item9: Marketing communications, only where you have given consent or as otherwise permitted by law
privacy.payment.heading: 4. Payment Security
privacy.payment.p1: All online payments on Tel-Aqua are securely processed through Razorpay, a PCI-compliant payment gateway. When you pay, your payment details are transmitted directly to Razorpay over encrypted connections.
privacy.payment.p2: We may retain limited payment metadata (such as payment status, transaction ID, and last four digits where provided by the gateway) solely for order records and dispute handling.
privacy.shipping.heading: 5. Shipping
privacy.shipping.p1: To deliver your order, we share necessary shipping information—such as your name, phone number, and delivery address—only with authorized logistics partners. We do not sell or rent this information to unrelated third parties.
privacy.shipping.p2: Our delivery partners are expected to use your information solely for fulfilling and tracking shipments and to protect it in accordance with applicable law.
privacy.cookies.heading: 6. Cookies
privacy.cookies.intro: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to support a smooth shopping experience. Cookies may be used for:
privacy.cookies.item1: Analytics and understanding how visitors use the site
privacy.cookies.item4: Maintaining cart and checkout state for a better shopping experience
privacy.cookies.outro: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect site functionality, such as remembering preferences or completing checkout.
privacy.protection.heading: 7. Data Protection
privacy.protection.p1: Tel-Aqua uses industry-standard technical and organizational measures to protect personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include secure hosting practices, access controls, and encrypted payment processing via Razorpay.
privacy.protection.p2: While we strive to protect your information, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure. We encourage you to use strong unique passwords where accounts apply and to contact us immediately if you suspect unauthorized use of your information.
privacy.rights.heading: 8. Customer Rights
privacy.rights.intro: Subject to applicable law, you may request:
privacy.rights.item1: Access to the personal information we hold about you
privacy.rights.item2: Correction of inaccurate or incomplete information
privacy.rights.item3: Deletion of personal information where we are not required to retain it
privacy.rights.item4: Assistance with account-related or order-related privacy queries
privacy.rights.outro: To submit a request, contact us using the details in the Contact Us section below. We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling certain requests.
privacy.third.heading: 9. Third-Party Services
privacy.third.intro: We work with trusted third-party services to operate our website and fulfill orders. These may include:
privacy.third.item2: Authorized delivery partners — for shipping and logistics
privacy.third.item3: Google Maps — for location or address-related features where used
privacy.third.item4: Google Analytics — for website analytics, where enabled
privacy.third.outro: Each third-party service processes data under its own privacy policy and terms. We encourage you to review those policies to understand how they handle information shared for their services.
privacy.children.heading: 10. Children's Privacy
privacy.children.p1: Our website and products are intended for adults and businesses. Tel-Aqua does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18 years of age. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can take appropriate steps to delete it.
privacy.changes.heading: 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
privacy.changes.p1: Tel-Aqua may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, legal requirements, or business operations. When we make material changes, we will update the “Last Updated” date at the top of this page.
privacy.changes.p2: We encourage you to review this policy periodically. Continued use of our website after an update constitutes acceptance of the revised policy, to the extent permitted by law.
